text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romaniaps press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:.
Business:.
BURSA:.
- The governmentps reform programme was "dictated" by international lenders, former farm minister Valeriu Tabara, senator of the opposition Romanian National Unity Party said..
ROMANIA LIBERA.
- The State Ownership Fund will privatise or liquidate 20 pig and poultry farms next month, under a programme made jointly with the World Bank..
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI.
- Prices for local-made medicaments are expected to soar by some 200 percent in March, due to recent petrol and electricity price hikes..
- Central bank governor Mugur Isarescu said a shortage of liquidity on the interbank market might strenghten the national currency..
- Prices of cigarettes and coffee rose by 30 percent, while prices for imported home appliances by 100 percent..
ADEVARUL.
- Year-on-year inflation in 1997 will reach 89.5 percent, Isarescu told a news conference..
- Loss-making mines will be closed within the next two years, Labour Minister Alexandru Athanasiu said. He said investors will be invited to upgrade equipments..
CURIERUL NATIONAL.
- McDonnell Douglas Corp. wants to buy stock in state-owned airline Tarom SA, the paper says..
General:
ROMANIA LIBERA
- The newspaper prints photographs of French President Jacques Chirac's aunt, Gabrielle Chirac, ahead of his visit to Bucharest. The aunt settled in Romania before World War Two.
- Romanians have great expectations from President Chirac, the newspaper says.
ADEVARUL
- Chirac starts historic visit to Romania on Friday, the newspaper says.
- Romania had 3,500 foreign adoptions in 1996, most of them to Italy (934) and the United States. (778).
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI

- President Emil Constantinescu asked the government to draft a law to allow former President Ion Iliescu to acquire a house free of charge for the rest of his life as a tribute to his status as former head of state. Iliescu said he did not need such a house.

- Protests started this week in the Jilava jail near Bucharest spread to six other jails over demands to improve overcrowded conditions and repeal tougher parole conditions. Convicts in Timisoara set their prison on fire.
- Ruling National Peasant Party secretary general Radu Vasile slammed the government for what he called "errors committed by dilettantes". ($= 7,744 lei) -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
